compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

The `concurrency` overlay prompt (prerequisite story) needs registration before it can run: `OVERLAY_IDS` (src/rebar/llm/code_review/registry.py:38) is the closed enum the base reviewer may escalate to; the overlay union is `glob ∪ content ∪ recommend` (src/rebar/llm/code_review/workflow_ops.py:98-110); and `content_triggered_overlays` (registry.py:321) currently fires only `deletion-impact`. Registration is sequenced AFTER the prompt so the workflow can never escalate to a dimension with no reviewer behind it.

## Approach

Four additive edits. (1) Add `"concurrency"` to `OVERLAY_IDS` — the base-output schema enum derives via `overlay_id_enum()` (registry.py:73), so no schema file edit. (2) Add a committed HIGH-PRECISION cross-stack token tuple and extend `content_triggered_overlays` to scan BOTH added and removed diff lines (file headers excluded) for these literal substrings, returning `concurrency` alongside the existing deletion-impact result. Token list (decided; survey-grounded in Lu et al. ASPLOS'08, Tu et al. ASPLOS'19, the RacerD trigger heuristic, and CodeQL CERT concurrency packs): `Mutex`, `RwLock`, `Lock(`, `Semaphore`, `synchronized`, `volatile`, `@GuardedBy`, `Interlocked.`, `Atomics.`, `pthread_`, `flock`, `fcntl.`, `O_EXCL`, `mkstemp`, `Thread(`, `go func(`, `tokio::spawn`, `Task.Run(`, `worker_threads`, `new Worker(`, `multiprocessing.`, `asyncio.create_task`, `asyncio.gather`, `concurrent.futures`, `os.fork(`, `cluster.fork(`, `sync.WaitGroup`, `sync.Once`, `make(chan `, `atomic.`, `FOR UPDATE`, `SKIP LOCKED`, `SERIALIZABLE`, `advisory_lock`, `NOWAIT`, `BEGIN IMMEDIATE`, `start_new_session`, `compare-and-swap`, `coroutineScope`, `launch {`. Deliberately EXCLUDED as too noisy for the committed tier (decided): the async/await family, bare `fork`, `retry`, `.lock`, `Popen`, `Promise.all(`, `setInterval(`, `select {` — that noisy tier is project-overlay material, delivered by the sibling dogfood story. (3) Add the one-line catalog entry to `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-base.md`: `concurrency — threads, async tasks, multiprocessing, locks, channels, shared/global mutable state, file/DB locking` (recognition cue only; the base reviewer does no concurrency analysis). (4) Add the routing entry to `src/rebar/llm/code_review/criteria_routing.json`: `exec: AGENT`, `applies_to: []`, `default_posture: advisory`, `block_threshold: 0.95`, `blocking_enabled: false`, with a `_comment` citing the survey and the calibrate-then-flip path. Positive rationale: RacerD's production precedent — a single lexical cue flips on the expensive analysis — and the recall-biased list is safe because an over-fire costs one advisory pass, never a wrong verdict. Measured fire rate of this tier on this repo's last 300 main commits: 14% (43/300); recorded here as calibration context.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/llm/code_review/registry.py` — `OVERLAY_IDS`, token tuple, `content_triggered_overlays` extension.
- `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-base.md` — catalog line.
- `src/rebar/llm/code_review/criteria_routing.json` — routing entry.
- `tests/unit/test_criteria_overlay.py` — trigger and routing cases.

## Testing

Unit tier (pure functions; no live boundary). Oracles: returned overlay-id lists and `threshold_for` output.

- Recall, corpus-derived: a diff hunk adding `start_new_session=True` (distilled from 9ad46965bd, the `eclectic-spotted-barb` introducing change) fires `concurrency`.
- Removal path: a diff REMOVING a `sync.Mutex` line fires (survey consequence: deleting synchronization is concurrency-introducing).
- Negative controls: a diff containing only `async def`/`await` lines does NOT fire `concurrency`; a token appearing only on a context (unprefixed) line does NOT fire; the existing deletion-impact behavior is unchanged on its current test corpus.
- Routing: `threshold_for("concurrency")` returns the advisory 0.95 / blocking-disabled posture.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `"concurrency"` is in `OVERLAY_IDS` and returned by `overlay_id_enum()`; checked by unit test.
- [ ] `content_triggered_overlays` returns `concurrency` for the corpus-derived added-line hunk AND for a removed `sync.Mutex` line; checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_criteria_overlay.py`.
- [ ] Negative controls pass: `async def`/`await`-only diffs and context-line-only tokens do not fire; deletion-impact results unchanged.
- [ ] `code-review-base.md` lists `concurrency` in the overlay catalog with the one-line cue; checked by grep.
- [ ] `threshold_for("concurrency")` asserts advisory/0.95/blocking-disabled; checked by unit test.
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and `pytest tests/unit/test_criteria_overlay.py` pass.
